screened_rule: paired-valid, no warning, no retrospective fallback in either direction; also at least 300 samples and matching LUT for G16 (the original validity allows up to 301)
hour_rule: UTC-aligned, disjoint 12-bin averages; every bin valid under the selected policy and one algorithm version
difference_rule: positive difference between contiguous complete equal-duration bins of the same algorithm version; no interpolation
numeric_meaning: descriptive statistics of serialized model bit-inversion first moments, not a physical event-rate or future derivative bound
